Nathan Lyon dropped by Australia for their first Test against New Zealand
Nathan Lyon was left out of Australia's 13-player squad for their first Test against New Zealand on December 9 in Perth; Uncapped off-spinner Corey Rocchiccioli comes into the squad; Lyon was omitted from Australia's second Test vs South Africa
Friday 27 November 2026 22:54, UK
Nathan Lyon has been dropped by Australia for their upcoming Test series against New Zealand in Perth.
The 39-year-old off-spinner has been a mainstay in the side for 13 years, with Lyon having taken 577 Test wickets from 145 matches.
Lyon has not spoken publicly since Usman Khawaja's explosive Sandpapergate claims were published in his autobiography.
- Sandpapergate forum to include 2017/18 Ashes series
- Sandpapergate explained as scandal re-enters the headlines
Australia selection chair George Bailey confirmed that his omission was not related to the ongoing saga, and was related to performances.
"Nathan has not quite had the impact we would like with the ball in recent matches," said Bailey.
"We also know he has an extraordinary record and his experience, knowledge and skill can still be valuable to the program we have moving forward."
In recent years, Lyon has seen his role with the Test side diminished, with a right hamstring injury sustained during day five of the third Ashes Test in 2025 ruling him out of selection for eight months.
He had previously been dropped for the second Ashes Test at The Gabba and spoke openly about the omission, admitting he was "filthy" and "gutted" about being dropped.
Lyon had also been omitted from Australia's second Test against South Africa.
Prior to last year's Test at The Gabba, the off-spinner had remarkably not been left out of a Test squad since he made his debut in 2011.
Uncapped Western Australia off-spinner Corey Rocchiccioli comes into the squad.
"Corey has been a strong performer in domestic cricket for the past few seasons and has traits that are well suited to Australian conditions," Bailey said.
More to follow…

נבחרת אוסטרליה החליטה להוציא את הספינר הוותיק ניית'ן ליון מסגל 13 השחקנים לקראת משחק המבחן הראשון שלהם מול ניו זילנד, שייערך בפרת'. ליון, בן 39, שימש עמוד תווך בנבחרת במשך 13 שנים וצבר 577 וויקטים ב-145 משחקי מבחן. יושב ראש הוועדה לבוחרים, ג'ורג' ביילי, הבהיר כי ההחלטה אינה קשורה לפרשות קודמות אלא מבוססת אך ורק על יכולת מקצועית לא לאחרונה.

במקומו של ליון הוזמן לסגל קורי רוצ'יצ'ולי, ספינר מערב אוסטרליה שטרם רשם הופעה בינלאומית והציג יכולת מרשימה בכדורגל המקומי בשנים האחרונות. ליון סבל לאחרונה מפגיעה בשריר הירך האחורי שהשביתה אותו לתקופה ארוכה, ובעבר כבר הוצא מהסגל במהלך סדרת האשס. בנבחרת מדגישים כי הניסיון והיכולות של ליון עדיין עשויים להיות בעלי ערך רב לתוכניות העתידיות של המערכת.
